name: pdk-eshop-catalog-authoritative-pricing-v2
instr:
Ordering currently trusts the price and name supplied by the checkout client. Make Catalog authoritative for `POST /api/orders` without changing `CreateOrderRequest` or the successful response shape. Accept an order only when every product exists in Catalog and each requested unit price equals its latest acknowledged price. Persist Catalog's name and price, not the supplied name. On a mismatch or unknown product return HTTP 400 naming all offending product IDs; do not create any part of the order. Keep the existing order flow and existing unit suites working; draft orders, discounts, Basket, item deletion and WebApp are outside this change.

Catalog's `POST /api/catalog/items`, `PUT /api/catalog/items/{id}` (v2), and delegated v1 `PUT /api/catalog/items` must publish every committed price on `eshop_event_bus` under `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent`, including created products. Each price event must expose `ProductId` (the item's integer ID), `NewPrice` (the committed decimal price), and a per-product `Version` starting at 1 for the creation event and incrementing by 1 for each committed price change, in commit order. Writes through separate Catalog instances must serialize per item; a broker outage must not lose acknowledged changes. Ordering must enforce a changed price within 5 seconds of Catalog acknowledging it, including rejection of the old price.
